## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New or changed analyses are cross-checked against an independent reference (PX4 source, Flight Review, Python/scipy) and covered by a unit test with synthetic data where possible
- [ ] UI changes checked in light and dark theme, at 100 / 125 / 150 % scaling
- [ ] `docs/` updated if the behaviour of a page changed

## Privacy

- [ ] No `.ulg`, `.params`, screenshots or test data with GPS positions, file names or vehicle identifiers from real flights
